'''Ted Skomars''' (also published as '''Ted Skonars''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 1999 Bristol tournament]] on 22 August 1999 with Speeder Bikes (non-objective), according to Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d17">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-23-bristol-connecticut-8-22-99d17/ bristol-connecticut-8-22-99], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 23 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-23-bristol-connecticut-8-22-99d17/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
